convert_smpl_3d_to_bbox_coords: convert SMPL 3D coordinates to bounding box space using scale and translation parameters
convert_bbox_coords_to_original_image: convert bounding box coordinates back to original image pixel coordinates using scale and offset
convert_smpl_to_bbox_with_perspective: convert SMPL 3D coordinates to bounding box with perspective projection using focal length
extract_bbox_from_openpose_json: extract bounding box center and scale from an OpenPose JSON detection file
extract_bbox_from_keypoints: extract bounding box center and scale from 2D keypoints with optional confidence threshold
